description: Fetch a Japanese law/ordinance by its e-Gov law id (from search_laws), e.g. "415AC0000000057". Returns the title, law number, promulgation date, and the law's full text, PAGED — use `offset`/`limit` to walk a long law; `has_more`/`next_offset` say whether another page follows. For a single article (incl. branch articles like 第二十七条の2), use japan_law_get_article instead — it is far cheaper than paging a whole law to find one provision. Pass `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD) to fetch the version of the law in force on that date. Source: e-Gov 法令検索.

as_of.description: Point-in-time date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the revision in force on that date instead of the current one.

limit.description: Max characters to return in this page (default 30000, max 60000).

offset.description: Character offset into the full text to start this page at (default 0).

name: get_law
title: Get Law
